zh.title: 紐約港舉行九一一事件25週年紀念無人機展演
zh.summary: 2977架無人機於紐約港重現雙塔輪廓；紀念九一一事件25週年
body: 據報導，在九一一恐怖攻擊事件25週年前夕，名為「紐約港上空的2977盞燈光」（2,977 Lights Over New York Harbor）的空中紀念藝術展演於2026年9月10日晚間在紐約港登場。這項展演一共動用了2,977架帶有照明設備的無人機，於夜空中呈現在九一一事件中罹難的每一位受害者。根據 AeroTime 報導，該活動免費開放民眾觀賞，旨在提供一個沉思與團結的公共紀念空間。
展演過程中，2,977架無人機最初以散落的燈點出現在夜空，隨後逐步凝聚成世界貿易中心雙塔的完整建築輪廓。在紐約港上方短暫維持雙塔造型後，無人機群再度散開並化為個別燈點。活動主辦方表示，這項視覺設計意在強調歷史數字背後每一位具體的受害者，而非僅是建築物本身。

本次展演所紀念的2,977名罹難者，包含在紐約世界貿易中心、維吉尼亞州阿靈頓五角大廈，以及因乘客反抗劫機者而墜毀於賓夕法尼亞州的聯合航空93號班機上的受害者。此外，活動也致敬了事發時奔赴現場的消防員、警察與急救人員，以及後續遭受健康影響的救援人員與倖存者。該計畫由多位九一一社群成員共同參與策劃，包括紐約市消防局急救人員 Brenda Berkman 與 Tim Brown，以及 9/11 Families United 主席 Terry Strada 等人。
美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 於社群媒體上分享了展演畫面，並對受害者、家屬及救援人員表達支持與追思。現場直播網路 EarthCam 亦記錄下無人機在紐約天際線前升起並構成雙塔的過程。主辦單位指出，隨著新一代年輕人在沒有九一一事件親身記憶的情況下成長，希望透過這項空中光影藝術，讓年輕世代直觀了解這起歷史事件的人文代價，並展現紐約的韌性與公共紀念的持續意義。

en.title: 2,977 Drones Recreate Twin Towers Over New York Harbor for 9/11 25th Anniversary
en.summary: 2,977 drones illuminated New York Harbor to recreate the Twin Towers for the 9/11 anniversary.
body: On the eve of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, a public commemorative drone light display titled '2,977 Lights Over New York Harbor' was presented over New York Harbor on the evening of September 10, 2026. The public art installation utilized 2,977 illuminated drones, with each drone representing one individual killed during the 2001 terrorist attacks. According to AeroTime, the event was organized as a free public gathering centered on reflection and unity.

During the display, the drones initially appeared as individual scattered points of light in the night sky before assembling into the detailed architectural outlines of the World Trade Center's Twin Towers. After holding the formation above New York Harbor, the array dissolved back into separate points of light. Event organizers noted that this visual transition was deliberately designed to emphasize the individual lives lost rather than focusing solely on the structural landmarks.

The tribute commemorated victims killed across multiple locations, including the World Trade Center in New York, the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, and onboard United Airlines Flight 93, which crashed in Pennsylvania. The display also honored first responders, emergency medical workers, survivors, and residents affected by long-term health impacts. The project was developed in close collaboration with members of the 9/11 community, including FDNY first responders Brenda Berkman and Tim Brown, as well as 9/11 Families United president Terry Strada.

US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy shared images of the aerial display on social media, expressing solidarity with the victims, their families, and service personnel. Additionally, live camera network EarthCam captured footage of the light formation against the New York City skyline. Organizers highlighted that the drone tribute aims to ensure younger generations understand the human cost of the September 11 attacks while symbolizing New York's enduring resilience.

zh.title: 亞馬遜空運貨機在邁阿密衝出跑道造成五人死傷
zh.summary: 機師稱速度過快；NTSB發布初步調查；飛機衝過機場外圍道路撞車
body: 根據美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）的最新資訊，亞馬遜空運（Amazon Air）編號為N123FE的波音767-33A(ER)貨機於2026年9月6日在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）著陸時，機師曾多次警告「速度過快」。
NTSB指出，機師在錄音結束前01分42秒首次表達對飛機速度的擔憂，之後在錄音餘段持續提及速度過快。
錄音顯示，在觸地前約01分04秒和00分57秒，地面警告系統兩次發出「sink rate sink rate」提示下降過快；之後在觸地前17秒內，機師五次收到「too low terrain」警告。
撞擊後，機師在左主輪着陸約15秒後要求復飛，飛行資料記錄器同時顯示推進器增加推力；隨後11秒後油門降至怠速並重新剎車。
NTSB表示，距離錄音結束前約10秒可聽見類似飛機離開鋪裝表面的聲音，最終記錄的地面速度為65節（約75英里/小時）。
事故導致機場外圍公路上一輛貨車被撞，造成五人死亡，死者皆為航空清潔公司員工，分別為Yoel Rodriguez Naranjo（53歲）、Rolando Aleman Leon（55歲）、Julio C. Pineda（75歲）、Carlos Acosta Fajardo（53歲）和Javierkys Reyes Quevedo（47歲）。
涉事飛機為服役32年的波音767-33A(ER)，由21 Air以亞馬遜空運名義操作，機師為55歲、擁有7,145飛行小時的前美國陸軍黑鷹飛行員；副機師為37歲、2,655飛行小時。

en.title: Amazon Air cargo jet overruns Miami runway, strikes vehicles killing five
en.summary: Pilot warned of excessive speed; NTSB releases preliminary findings; aircraft veered off airport perimeter onto road
body: According to the latest information from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), the Amazon Air flight operating as N123FE, a Boeing 767-33A(ER) freighter, warned its pilots that the aircraft was “too fast” on approach to Miami International Airport (MIA) on September 6, 2026.

The NTSB reported that the captain first voiced concerns about excessive speed 1 minute 42 seconds before the end of the cockpit voice recording, repeating such comments throughout the remainder of the recording.

In the recording, a sink‑rate warning sounded “sink rate sink rate” at 1:04 and 0:57 before touchdown, and the terrain alert “too low terrain” was issued five times within the final 17 seconds before impact.

About 15 seconds after the nose and right main gear first touched down, a pilot called for a go‑around, matching the flight data recorder’s application of go‑around thrust; 11 seconds later the throttles were reduced to idle and the brakes reapplied.
Ten seconds before the end of the recording, sounds similar to the aircraft departing the paved surface could be heard; the final recorded ground speed was 65 knots (about 75 mph).

The aircraft overran the airport perimeter, crossed a public road and struck a van owned by an aircraft‑cleaning company, killing all five occupants: Yoel Rodriguez Naranjo (53), Rolando Aleman Leon (55), Julio C. Pineda (75), Carlos Acosta Fajardo (53) and Javierkys Reyes Quevedo (47).

The 32‑year‑old Boeing 767-33A(ER) was operated by 21 Air on behalf of Amazon Air; the captain, a former U.S. Army Black Hawk pilot, is 55 years old with 7,145 flight hours, while the first officer is 37 with 2,655 hours.
